content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user managing my personal task list","i_want":"to mark a task as Completed","so_that":"I can record that the work on the task is finished","business_description":"The to-do management page lets the user change a task's status to Completed. The backend stores the new status and records the Completion Date and Last Updated Date. The frontend shows the new status only after the backend confirms the change, and shows a success or error message for each attempt.","business_value":"Users can track finished work without editing the whole task, and the report counts of Open and Completed tasks stay accurate.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"a task with status Open exists","when":"the user marks the task as Completed and the backend confirms the change","then":"the backend stores the status Completed and the task list shows the task with status Completed"},{"given":"the status change request for an existing task succeeds in the backend","when":"the frontend receives the success response","then":"the row shows status Completed and a success message is displayed"},{"given":"the status change request for an existing task fails in the backend","when":"the frontend receives the failure","then":"the task list still shows the previous status, no success message is displayed, and an error message is displayed"},{"given":"a status change request is pending and the backend has not responded yet","when":"the task list is displayed","then":"the row still shows the previous status and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"a status change request is sent for a task ID that does not exist","when":"the backend processes the request","then":"the backend returns a task not found error and no stored task changes"},{"given":"a status change request is sent with a status value other than Completed","when":"the backend validates the request","then":"the backend rejects the request with an invalid changes nothing.","A status change request with a status value other than Completed is rejected with an invalid input error.","A status change request is pending: the row keeps the previous status and no success message is shown until the backend responds.","The PRD does not state what happens when a task that is already Completed is marked as Completed again. Open question: should the request be rejected, accepted without changing Completion Date, or accepted with a new Completion Date?","The PRD does not state the exact wording of the success message.
